title: Intel 100G CWDM4 QSFP28 Optical Transceiver Module

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Intel 100G CWDM4 QSFP28 Optical Transceiver Module is a high-performance 100Gbps solution designed for next-generation data centers, cloud networks, and enterprise core infrastructures. Using CWDM4 technology, this Intel QSFP28 module transmits four wavelengths (1271–1331nm) over single-mode fiber (SMF), ensuring reliable 100G connectivity up to 2 kilometers.


Built for efficiency and stability, the Intel 100G CWDM4 module offers low power consumption (<3.5W), strong thermal performance, and full compliance with MSA and IEEE 802.3bm standards. It delivers seamless interoperability with major switches, routers, and servers, making it an ideal upgrade for high-bandwidth environments in Bangladesh.


Choose D CORE for original, high-quality Intel optical transceivers to enhance your network capacity with confidence.
